name: Opening and Closing on time v2
summary: This EA opens and closes positions at specified times of day, allowing traders to automate trading during preferred market sessions. It places buy or sell orders at user-defined hours and minutes, and closes all or specific positions at designated times. The strategy is purely time-based without any technical indicator confirmation.
summary_zh: 该EA在用户指定的时间点自动开仓和平仓，允许交易者在偏好的市场时段进行自动化交易。它在设定的时和分下达买入或卖出订单，并在指定时间关闭全部或特定仓位。该策略完全基于时间驱动，不使用任何技术指标确认。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念是基于时间段交易，在特定的市场时段（如伦敦开盘、纽约开盘等）自动执行交易，利用这些时段的高波动性和流动性优势。入场条件完全依赖用户设定的时间参数，当服务器时间到达指定的开仓时间和分钟时，EA会按照预设方向（买入或卖出）下单，没有任何技术指标过滤。出场条件同样基于时间，当到达用户设定的平仓时间时，EA会关闭所有或指定类型的持仓。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，用户直接设定交易手数，没有根据账户余额或风险比例动态调整的机制。资金管理方面非常简单，仅提供固定手数参数，缺乏动态仓位计算、最大持仓限制或回撤控制等功能。整体策略逻辑极其简洁，适合对特定时段行情有明确判断的交易者使用，但也因此缺乏市场状态适应能力。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is session-based trading, automatically executing trades at specific market sessions (such as London open or New York open) to capitalize on their higher volatility and liquidity. Entry conditions rely entirely on user-defined time parameters; when server time reaches the specified opening hour and minute, the EA places a buy or sell order in the preset direction without any technical indicator filtering. Exit conditions are also time-based, closing all or specific positions when the user-defined closing time is reached. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach where the user directly sets the trade volume, with no dynamic adjustment based on account balance or risk ratio. Money management is very simplistic, offering only a fixed lot parameter and lacking dynamic position calculation, maximum position limits, or drawdown controls. The overall strategy logic is extremely simple, suitable for traders with clear convictions about specific session behavior, but it lacks market state adaptability as a result.

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description_en: Stop loss amount, 0 disables overall stop loss

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description_en: Hedge pair net profit target in points

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for order identification

pros: 逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和配置，适合新手交易者
能够精确捕捉特定市场时段的波动机会，如主要市场开盘时段
自动化执行避免了人工延迟和情绪干扰，确保时间精准性
支持止损和止盈设置，提供基本的风险控制手段
可灵活配置多个开仓和平仓时间点，适应不同交易计划
pros_en: Simple and clear logic, easy to understand and configure, suitable for novice traders
Can precisely capture volatility opportunities during specific market sessions like major market opens
Automated execution avoids manual delays and emotional interference, ensuring time precision
Supports stop loss and take profit settings, providing basic risk control
Flexible configuration of multiple opening and closing times to adapt to different trading schedules
cons: 完全没有技术指标确认，纯时间驱动入场，可能在不合适的市场状态下开仓
缺乏动态仓位管理，固定手数无法根据账户风险自动调整
没有检查是否已有同方向持仓，可能导致重复开仓和过度暴露
没有新K线检查机制，可能在同一时间周期内重复发单
缺乏点差过滤，在流动性较低的时段可能以较大点差入场
cons_en: No technical indicator confirmation at all, purely time-driven entry may open positions in unfavorable market conditions
Lacks dynamic position sizing; fixed lot size cannot automatically adjust based on account risk
No check for existing positions in the same direction, potentially causing duplicate entries and overexposure
No new bar check mechanism, may send duplicate orders within the same time period
Lacks spread filter, may enter with wide spreads during low-liquidity sessions
improvements: 增加技术指标过滤条件（如均线方向、RSI超买超卖），避免逆势开仓
实现动态仓位计算，根据账户余额和风险比例自动调整手数
添加持仓检查和新K线检查，防止重复开仓
增加点差过滤和最大滑点限制，保护交易执行质量
improvements_en: Add technical indicator filters (e.g., moving average direction, RSI overbought/oversold) to avoid counter-trend entries
Implement dynamic position sizing that automatically adjusts lot size based on account balance and risk ratio
Add position check and new bar check to prevent duplicate entries
Add spread filter and maximum slippage limit to protect trade execution quality

risk_points: 纯时间驱动无技术确认，可能在不利行情下开仓造成较大亏损
没有持仓检查机制，可能重复开仓导致过度暴露
固定手数缺乏风险比例控制，大仓位交易可能造成重大损失
risk_points_en: Purely time-driven without technical confirmation may open positions in unfavorable conditions causing significant losses
No position check mechanism may lead to duplicate entries and overexposure
Fixed lot size lacks risk ratio control; large position trading may cause substantial losses
